title: gymnanthemum esculentum
intro: Gymnanthemum esculentum, commonly known as African basil or Lemon Basil, is a type of herb native to tropical Africa. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that can aid in reducing stress, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Gymnanthemum esculentum include its ability to act as an anti-anxiety and anti-depressant agent, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include essential oils like eugenol, linalool, and geraniol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
